## Grading {#grading}

Everything is out of **100 marks**.

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Marks</th><th>How</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th>Quizzes</th><td class="big">54</td><td>Three closed-book quizzes, a mix of short conceptual questions and problems. Your <strong>best two</strong> count, 27 marks each. No makeup quizzes: a missed quiz is one of the dropped scores.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Assignments</th><td class="big">39</td><td>Three programming assignments in Python and PyTorch, 13 marks each, each extending code from a lecture notebook. After each deadline, every student takes a <strong>short individual quiz or viva</strong> on their own submission: you explain your code, your plots and your choices, and your marks reflect that conversation.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Attendance</th><td class="big">7</td><td>Recorded on the biometric system. It is your responsibility to make sure it registers.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><td class="big">100</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

### Attendance {#attendance}

```{=html}
<table class="t att" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Classes missed</th><th>Marks</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>≤ 4</td><td>7</td></tr><tr><td>5–6</td><td>5</td></tr><tr><td>7–8</td><td>3</td></tr><tr><td>9–10</td><td>1</td></tr><tr><td>&gt; 10</td><td>0</td></tr></tbody></table>
```

There is no leave-request system; a missed class is an absence. For a genuine emergency that forces you to miss several classes in a row, talk to the instructor.

### AI tools {#ai}

Use AI tools honestly and document meaningful assistance. What is assessed is your ability to explain your own decisions and results in the viva.

:::
